summary.en-US: Save your family's pilgrim details once and fill the TTD (Tirumala) darshan booking forms in one click. Unofficial, free and open source. Nothing leaves your browser.

description.en-US:
**Unofficial.** Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD).

TTD Quick Fill keeps your pilgrims (name, age, gender, Aadhaar or passport number) and optional contact details in your browser's extension storage and types them into the TTD online booking forms for you.

**What it does**

- Fills the Special Entry Darshan and Sri PAT pilgrim-details form (including the General Details block) and the Srivani form on ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in, from the popup or from a floating button on the page.
- On any other TTD pilgrim form (Arjitha seva, Angapradakshinam, senior-citizen darshan and similar) it finds the pilgrim rows by their labels and fills them the same way, then asks you to check every value.\n- Reports exactly which fields it filled and which you must enter by hand.
- Only fills rows that are completely empty; it never overwrites what you typed.\n- Optional passphrase protection: your saved details are then stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key derived with PBKDF2-SHA256) and unlocked once per browser session.

**What it never does**

- Never presses Continue, Pay Now or Submit.
- Never solves CAPTCHAs and never touches payment.
- Has no server, makes no network requests, and collects no analytics or telemetry. Your data stays on your device and is deleted when you uninstall.

**Permissions:** storage (your saved pilgrims) and access to the two TTD booking sites only. No network access.

Free and open source under the MIT licence. Source code, issues and contributions: https://github.com/patanjaliv/ttd-quick-fill

release_notes.en-US: 0.3.1: recognises the Arjitha seva slot-booking pilgrim-details page on ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in (/arjitha-seva/slot-booking) and fills it the same way as the Special Entry page; also loads on the two TTD domains' sub-portals. Nothing else changed. Still never presses Continue, Pay or Submit.

version.approval_notes: Unofficial helper for the TTD (Tirumala) darshan booking site. The booking site requires a pilgrim login, so for review without an account: the repository ships a mock of the pilgrim-details form (e2e/mock/pilgrim-details.html, a React controlled form using TTD's real field names) and an end-to-end test (npm run test:e2e) that loads the extension in Firefox and fills it. All source is unminified and human readable; no build step transforms it. The extension makes no network requests of its own, and only reads/writes extension storage plus the DOM of the two TTD hosts in host_permissions. Version 0.2.0 adds shared/vault.js: optional AES-GCM encryption of storage.local data with a user passphrase (WebCrypto only, no external code); the derived key is cached in storage.session; background.js (event page) answers the content script's READ message with the decrypted details so the content script never handles the key. Version 0.3.0 adds content/generic.js (loaded before content/fill.js): a label-based fallback that only runs when neither existing form detector matches; it fills empty pilgrim fields found by their visible labels and never submits. A mock for review is demo/mock/generic-seva.html. Version 0.3.1 adds one path check so the Arjitha seva slot-booking page (same host, same form) is handled by the existing pilgrim-details adapter, and widens the host patterns to the same two TTD domains' subdomains (https://*.ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in/*, https://*.tirupatibalaji.ap.gov.in/*) because TTD hosts some sevas on subdomains.
